description:
Configure the Vital Recorder display to show ONLY the 'essential' vital sign trends for the full duration of the loaded case, and export a PDF report.

Starting with VitalDB Case #3 loaded:
1. Configure the track display to SHOW ONLY these 4 tracks (remove/hide all others, such as ECG waveforms, Pleth waves, etc.):
   - Heart Rate (HR)
   - Mean Arterial Pressure (ART_MBP or MBP)
   - Oxygen Saturation (SPO2)
   - End-Tidal CO2 (ETCO2 or CO2)

2. Adjust the time view to fit the ENTIRE recording duration on the screen (Zoom Out / Fit to Screen).

3. Print the resulting view to a PDF file:
   - Use File > Print (or Ctrl+P)
   - Select 'Microsoft Print to PDF' as the printer
   - Save the file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\case3_summary.pdf'

The final PDF must contain only the requested data trends for the whole case.
